aiConsent.title: Share content with OpenAI?
aiConsent.body: FlacronCV's AI tools use OpenAI, a third-party AI provider (servers in the United States). When you use one, the content it needs is sent to OpenAI: for example your CV, career profile, cover letters, job descriptions, interview answers, coach messages, or a recording you ask to transcribe. Nothing is sent until you allow it. You can change this in Settings > Your data.
aiConsent.declined: Not sent. This tool needs your permission to share content with OpenAI. You can allow it in Settings > Your data.
